expected_source: the sequence and the register semantics are SPRU975E section 4 (MDIO control, ALIVE, LINK and the USERACCESS GO/ACK handshake) and IEEE 802.3 clause 22 (BMCR, BMSR, the PHY identifier, the auto-negotiation advertisement registers and the 1000BASE-T status): the module reports no PHY until it is enabled, a read of an unpopulated address does not acknowledge, ANAR round trips while BMSR does not, and the negotiated gigabit full duplex turns into MACCONTROL bits GIG, FULLDUPLEX and GMIIEN
